hooks.command: if [ -n "${CURSOR_VERSION:-}" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && jq -e --arg command '"${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.jstack/vendor/plugins/flow"/hooks/prompt.sh' '(.hooks.beforeSubmitPrompt // []) | any(.command == $command and .timeout == 10)' "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}/.cursor/hooks.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.jstack/vendor/plugins/flow/hooks/prompt.sh"

if [ -n "${CURSOR_VERSION:-}" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && jq -e --arg command '"${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.jstack/vendor/plugins/flow"/hooks/guard.sh' '(.hooks.beforeShellExecution // []) | any(.command == $command and .timeout == 10)' "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}/.cursor/hooks.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.jstack/vendor/plugins/flow/hooks/guard.sh"

if [ -n "${CURSOR_VERSION:-}" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && jq -e --arg command '"${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.jstack/vendor/plugins/flow"/hooks/stop.sh' '(.hooks.stop // []) | any(.command == $command and .timeout == 10 and .loop_limit == 3)' "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}/.cursor/hooks.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.jstack/vendor/plugins/flow/hooks/stop.sh"
